Aircraft Systems

फ्लाई-बाय-वायर

An electronic flight control system where pilot inputs are transmitted as electrical signals to computers, which command the flight control surfaces.

Quick answer: An electronic flight control system where pilot inputs are transmitted as electrical signals to computers, which command the flight control surfaces.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

An electronic flight control system where pilot inputs are transmitted as electrical signals to computers, which command the flight control surfaces.

Operational example

Fly-by-wire system reconfigured due to flight control computer fault, switching to alternate control law.

Localized term

फ्लाई-बाय-वायर

Localized example

फ्लाई-बाय-वायर सिस्टम कंप्यूटर फॉल्ट के कारण फिर से कॉन्फ़िगर किया गया, वैकल्पिक नियंत्रण कानून पर स्विच हो रहा है।
